object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Change only the acknowledged commit of an object's outgoing link and commit. Expected: the object is Link reviewed, not Modified, and no link is reported added or removed; the Compare dialog's row says Link reviewed and the counts say 1 link reviewed. Acknowledging a link that had no acknowledged commit is also Link reviewed. Changing an acknowledged commit and the description together is Modified, not Link reviewed.
